_comment: Seed for the data table om_poc_validation_rules. kind=rule rows are scored by EvaluateRules/ComputeDecision; kind=setting rows carry a threshold only. Seed with scripts/seed-validation-rules.py (public template copy).

rows.name: PO exists in system of record
rows.description: The extracted PO number matches a purchase order on record. Hard: a miss always routes to review.

rows.name: Vendor matches PO vendor
rows.description: Extracted vendor name overlaps the PO vendor, or the sender domain matches the vendor master. Hard.

rows.name: Currency matches PO
rows.description: Document currency equals the PO currency.

rows.name: Line count matches PO
rows.description: Number of extracted lines equals the number of PO lines.

rows.name: Every line maps to a PO line
rows.description: Each extracted line matches a PO line by SKU, or by line number as a fallback.

rows.name: Quantities within ordered quantity
rows.description: No extracted line quantity exceeds the ordered quantity.

rows.name: Unit prices within tolerance of PO
rows.description: Per-line unit price drift against the PO, in percent. threshold = allowed drift.

rows.name: Document total equals sum of lines
rows.description: Document total against the sum of extracted line totals. threshold = allowed difference in currency units.

rows.name: Document total within tolerance of PO total
rows.description: Document total against the PO total, in percent. threshold = allowed drift.

rows.name: Auto-post threshold
rows.description: A score at or above this posts without a human, unless a hard rule failed.

rows.name: Model confidence share of the score
rows.description: score = (1 - AI_WEIGHT) * weighted rules score + AI_WEIGHT * extraction_confidence.
